document_notes: Page 265 of PIR contains entries for ATILIVS, specifically M. Atilius Postumus Bradua (1303), T. Atilius Rufus (1304), and T. Atilius Rufus Titianus (1305). Only T. Atilius Rufus (1304) is relevant to the PROVINCIA corpus as he is explicitly attested as legatus Aug. pro pr. of Pannonia and Syria.
